context.purpose: Fit a small numeric calibration or explanatory model, optionally quantify classical coefficient uncertainty, and decide whether actual finite training/held-out fit/prediction results and coefficient intervals meet named requirements.
context.assumptions: Unweighted additive numeric ordinary least squares. Rows use declared predictor order followed by observed response, with plain unit labels. Fixed native symbols and vanilla Rscript; fresh RDS replay, independent QR verification. Optional inference assumes a correct additive mean, independent constant-variance normal errors and fixed predictors.
context.constraints: One to eight predictors, four to 512 training rows and optional one to 512 separate held-out rows. Training rows exceed coefficient count; full rank and actual scaled rectangular infinity-norm condition at most1e6. Inference level 0.5 to 0.999 and residual scatter at least 1e6 times the comparison roundoff allowance. No categorical/missing values, arbitrary formulas/scripts/models, weights, interactions, prediction intervals, multiplicity adjustment or generalisation guarantee.
context.inspection: Review coefficients with original predictor/response units in regression-summary.json, actual training/held-out residuals in CSV and each signed requirement margin/worst sampled condition. With inference, review standard errors, t, p, intervals, residual degrees of freedom, R-squared basis and stated assumptions in the summary and inference.csv. Native comparison uses relative1e-10 plus128*ULP(max training response magnitude)*max(1,scaled condition); inference uses 1e-4 relative with propagated p-value intervals and exact level/df readback.
context.recovery: RANK_DEFICIENT_DATA/ILL_CONDITIONED_DATA/INSUFFICIENT_DATA need independent predictors and a supported design. NO_RESIDUAL_VARIANCE means an exact or roundoff-level fit: remove inference or use measured data with scatter. UNSUPPORTED_INFERENCE needs a rescaled response. INVALID_REQUIREMENT needs valid scopes/indices/terms/bounds and inference for coefficient intervals. FIT_REQUIREMENT_NOT_MET retains valid fit evidence and needs review of data/model or justified requirements then a fresh attempt. Configure qualified Rscript for INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND; retain logs for native faults.

workflow.scope: Verified numeric prediction/fit tables into Calc with preserved numeric columns and independently checked workbook values.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure values and explicit finite analytic visits; each visit independently validates native fit and requirements.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers fit, saved-model reopen and final independent CPU verification; shared native kit has a separate bounded watchdog.
lifecycle.cancellation: Owned process cancellation covers native stages; cancellation is checked again before successful publication.
lifecycle.logs: Retain authored/effective plans, canonical numeric inputs, fixed native worker, launcher/input bindings, model.rds, native tables, optional native inference/statistics tables, runtime records, stage stdout/stderr/submissions and failed/success results.
lifecycle.verification: Independent column-scaled Householder QR reconstructs coefficients/predictions/residuals; actual rectangular infinity-norm condition from QR unit-vector solves gates unsupported designs. Compare native model rank/df, fit values and fresh-process RDS replay; recompute finite requirements from checked native values. Launcher/source/model bindings reject stale readback even with refreshed ordinary hashes. Retained regular descriptor reads are nonblocking and bounded8MiB. Optional inference compares native summary.lm/confint/pf values with QR-derived standard errors and standard-library Student-t/F tails, exact level/df readback and fit/reopen equality.

losses: Coefficient labels and physical unit meaning require accompanying summary.
Finite authored rows only; no physical or generalisation guarantee.
data.scope: Coefficient indices/estimates, training observations/predictions/residuals, and optional held-out predictions.

losses: No causal inference, prediction intervals, multiplicity adjustment or continuous/future prediction proof; optional coefficient inference holds only under the stated error assumptions.
data.scope: Named coefficients/unit descriptors, numerical conditioning/rank, actual native fit metrics, optional classical inference with assumptions, and explicit acceptance.

losses: Coefficient names, units, confidence level and assumptions require the accompanying summary.
Valid only under independent, constant-variance, normal errors and a correct additive mean.
data.scope: Optional per-coefficient estimate, standard error, t statistic, two-sided p-value and confidence limits, appended after the summary.

inspection.scope: Inspect finite numeric native predictions and signed residuals, preserving sample order.
inspection.limits: At most512 rows; no statistical plots or native interactive editor.

inspection.scope: Review declared units, coefficients, measured metrics, optional coefficient inference and assumptions, signed bound margins and numerical fidelity limits.
inspection.limits: RDS remains native evidence, not imported or cross-machine interchange.

cases.scope: Orthogonal residuals preserve independently known intercept10/slope2; both finite RMSE values equal sqrt(.025).
Declared slope3 changes predictions while orthogonal errors preserve intercept10 and RMSE sqrt(.025).
Literal y=2*x is fitted through the origin with one coefficient and zero errors; no held-out table is published.
Sixteen-row orthogonal sign design: intercept10 and eight independent coefficients1..8; full native rank9.
Closed-form two-df inference: slope SE sqrt(.005), t 20*sqrt(2), p 2/(s(s+t)) with s=sqrt(802), 95% critical value .95*sqrt(2/.0975), R-squared 400/401 and F 800; slope interval inside [1.5, 2.5].
Eight orthogonal residuals of 0.1 V with six df: sigma sqrt(.08/6), slope SE sigma/sqrt(168), intercept SE sigma/sqrt(8), R-squared 1512/1512.08, F 113400; tabulated t(0.95, 6) = 1.943180.

completion.scope: Opt-in classical coefficient inference (inference.level), coefficientInterval requirements, NO_RESIDUAL_VARIANCE/UNSUPPORTED_INFERENCE guards, appended inference.csv publication, plus route-level Studio library, discovery metadata and search cases. Covers these changes; existing regression/Calc behaviour is re-run but not re-reviewed beyond its regression evidence.

notApplicable.native-inspection: Batch fits keep no live native model browser; users inspect verified summary/CSV publications, and RDS is replay evidence only.
notApplicable.mpi: At most 512 rows and 9 coefficients fit in one single-threaded vanilla Rscript process; distributed execution adds no capability.
notApplicable.time-batches: Rows are a static table of declared observations with no time axis to batch.
notApplicable.live-editing: Every revision is planned and fitted in a fresh vanilla Rscript process; no persistent native session exists to edit.
notApplicable.native-save: model.rds is retained native replay evidence, deliberately not offered as an exported or imported model.
notApplicable.conversion: Inputs are inline numeric rows and outputs are numeric CSV/JSON publications; there is no format conversion to offer.
